name: 3-Participant Collaborative Rating Demo
description: Multi-participant proof experiment created entirely as an experiment package.

stimulus.value: Read the scenario, rate it individually, discuss as a group, then rate it again.
A team must choose between a fast uncertain option and a slower reliable option.

response.prompt: How strongly do you prefer the reliable option?

stimulus.value: Discuss your reasoning with the group.

response.prompt: After discussion, how strongly do you prefer the reliable option?
